title: The report guard refuses a claim of a posted review record or PR comment that gives no comment URL
why: Incident: lane notes-fix-page reported at 14:54 CST Nov 7 that the round-1 review record for #1500 was posted; it was posted at 15:01 CST. Harm: a runner trusts a record that does not exist.
note: lint/report_guard.py refuses such a line. Topic report-guard. Red test first.
